about: P-17 labelled sample (fix-pay-data, 2026-10-10). For each skill label: the postings in the 8 stable snapshots that carried it with the norm-5 lexicon, split into "removed" (the norm-6 patterns drop it) and "kept"; a deterministic spread sample of each, judged by hand from the matched contexts: truth "tp" when the role itself involves the skill, "fp" when the word was used in another sense (personal autonomy, "embedded in the business", "AI/ML companies", "4,300 CAD per week", "VAT mechanisms", a degree list). text = title + the matched contexts; test/fix-pay-data.test.js re-runs extractKeywords on it.
